posts.author: nevigovar
posts.body: Hi! I have a location of a descending elevator and I would like to understand how to make a slight shaking. Through the shaking plugin it is too strong, through the shaking of events it is also strong... Maybe there are plugins?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
If the Shake Screen event command is too strong, even all the way down at 1, you can look up the script call for it and try supplying a decimal value - I haven't looked at the code to see if that will work.
You wouldn't need any kind of plugin.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Yes, non-integer shake power seems to work, e.g.
$gameScreen.startShake(0.2, 10, 60);
